notes.t110: gpio73=PC9 status LED (0.5s heartbeat, now via .dtsi gpio-leds); gpio58=PB26 SD-CD active-low (STOCK DTB ground truth 2026-11-05, vempi: cd-gpios <&gpb 26> ACTIVE_LOW + cd-inverted TOGETHER — vendor sdhci keys GPIO detect off cd-inverted alone; earlier PB27/PB30 SD-CD theories wrong, stock PB27 is USB OTG drvvbus and PB30 is absent from stock DT) + gpio30=PA30 reset button + led_b now flow through the .dtsi fragment (kernel DT, U-Boot injection, BUTTON_PIN all derive from it); gpio61=PB29 SD power (active-low enable, BENCH-CONFIRMED 2026-10-26 via U-Boot gpio clear 61 + mmc rescan; stays runtime-side via gpio.mmc_power -> S09mmc); gpio57=PB25 WLAN enable stays in wlan seq (user-corrected 2026-11-10: wifi gpio is 57, not 60/PB28 REGON); speaker amp en gpio63. gpio46=IR LED, gpio49/50=ircut pair, gpio75=white lamp (reserve until hardware-verified). MOTORS (decoded 2026-10-27 from stock motor.ko by Josh, SMHLROQP cipher, letter = GPIO code-64): pan wires SMHL = PC19/PC13/PC8/PC12 = gpio 83/77/72/76, tilt wires ROQP = PC18/PC15/PC17/PC16 = gpio 82/79/81/80; stock bit-to-wire convention (disassembly Oct-28) is bit0 = FIRST wire, bit3 = LAST, and the driver maps st1..st4 = bit3..bit0, so the json strings must list wires in stock RING order: pan M,L,H,S = 77/76/72/83, tilt P,Q,O,R = 80/81/79/82 (2026-11-04 golden-bench: Josh's WORKING device runs reverse-ring pan S,L,H,M = 83/76/72/77, tilt R,O,Q,P = 82/79/81/80 — same excitation cycle, opposite spin direction; gpio_pan re-corrected to 83 77 72 76 (S,M,H,L wire order) by Josh 2026-11-10, tilt golden order unchanged. Builds 1-4 additionally shipped ascending-sorted strings which scrambled the tilt excitation ring = non-adjacent coil pairs = near-zero torque twitch) (PC bank = offset 64; pin numbers below 64 were a bank-offset transcription error, shipped in build a0cc3c3 and bench-proven wrong 2026-10-28 — tilt pins landed on PB17/PB18 = the ircut pair, solenoid click with no pan/tilt motion), steps 5300/1100. Requires package/ingenic-sdk 0004 patch (4.4.94 unified module-param interface). No limit switches. Homing stays off until arrow-pad direction is bench-proven.
